value.rationale: The Chilean divisor is the natural full 12-conic configuration coming from elliptic flex tangent duality. Its exact arithmetic class and zeta describe the entire extension-field distribution of singular points and components and classify sharp rational-point extremes not visible in the geometric \((9_8,12_6)\) data. Two explicit realizations show that a geometrically large conic arrangement may have either one rational point despite no rational component or no rational point at all, with exact extension-degree restrictions. These are natural arithmetic invariants of a motivated object, not arbitrary parameter slices or numerical experiments.
